title: Revit Working Library - Lighting Fixture Mounts

entries.name: Fixture-integrated mount
use_when: mount is inseparable from the luminaire
not reused as a separate project-specific hardware item

entries.name: Engineered lighting mount
use_when: participates in a defined load path
requires engineering review, calculation or sign-off

entries.name: Auxiliary mount or adapter
use_when: hardware is separate from luminaire assembly
needs distinct coordination, visibility or scheduling

working_rules: Engineered, dimensioned or primary load-bearing mounts should not be hidden inside a Lighting Fixtures family.
Fixture-integrated non-engineered mounts may remain part of the Lighting Fixtures family.
Auxiliary hardware may use a separate non-structural category where distinct coordination/scheduling is needed.
Structural responsibility and Revit categorization should remain visible to coordination and review workflows.

provenance.migration_note: Specialist lighting-mount categorization and parameter ideas retained as non-authoritative working knowledge; source organization/project branding removed.
